description: The bar chart illustrates retrieval performance measured as MAP@10 for different values of the parameter m under two sampling strategies. The horizontal axis contains the categorical m values (6, 7, 8, 9, 10), shown twice as two visually separated clusters corresponding to the two strategies, and the axis is labeled “m” with evenly spaced category positions (no explicit sorting beyond ascending m within each cluster). The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “MAP@10” on a linear scale ranging from 23.0 to 27.0, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A legend in the upper right maps purple bars to “Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy” and yellow bars to “Uniform Sampling Strategy.” In the left cluster (purple, Fine-to-Coarse), the approximate bar heights are: m=6 at about 25.9, m=7 at about 26.7–26.8, m=8 at about 26.3, m=9 at about 26.5–26.6, and m=10 at about 26.4–26.5. In the right cluster (yellow, Uniform), the approximate bar heights are: m=6 at about 24.4, m=7 at about 24.7–24.8, m=8 at about 25.6, m=9 at about 25.2, and m=10 at about 24.4. The bars are not stacked; they are shown as separate single-series bars arranged in two strategy-specific groups with a gap between the groups, and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the color encoding and gridlines.
